machines.name: Karplus
machines.description: A plucked string: a pick excites a tuned delay line that rings and fades.

machines.name: Drone
machines.description: Detuned saw stack with sub, fifth and a drifting resonant filter, for slow evolving drones.

machines.name: Solar
machines.description: Five free-running negistor saws per voice after the Elta Solar drone voices, with light modulation and cross-FM.

machines.name: Papa Srapa
machines.description: Two Schmitt-trigger oscillators after the Papa Srapa voices of the Elta Solar: sirens, birds, monsters, volleys and surf.

machines.name: Vibe
machines.description: A micro-looper inspired by Mood, and ambient effect with reverb, delay, modulation and randomized tape fragments.

machines.name: matriXY
machines.description: matriXY: an 8x8 pin matrix on a 3D wire terrain. X/Y place three pins; press to grab the next. Tilt sets a ratio of the note.

machines.name: Troupe
machines.description: Ten-character table-based vocal ensemble with bounded rendering and 24 active note states.

machines.name: FM DYN
machines.description: The Monomachine's FM+DYN, fitted to the original: M1 with pitch and depth envelopes, M2 with its decay and feedback.

machines.name: breadboard
machines.description: A raw dual-oscillator breadboard synth with wave shaping, octave-shifted sub, ring modulation and noisy digital character.

machines.name: Scales
machines.description: Keeps every note in one key: notes outside the scale snap to it, rest, or play from the white keys; chords stay diatonic.

machines.name: Wane
machines.description: Analogue-style pads heard through one worn, shared tape: detuned morphing oscillators that drift, with wow, flutter, sag and age.

machines.name: Bloom
machines.description: Breathing additive pads: 24 sine partials shaped by tilt, shape, stretch and a sung vowel, drifting, beating in detuned pairs and blurring into breath.

machines.name: Hollow
machines.description: A resonator choir: breath and a soft bow through tuned bodies (vox, string, pipe, glass) whose held notes ring sympathetically into each other.

machines.name: Orbit
machines.description: A vector synth: four vintage digital waves at a diamond's corners, mixed by a point that orbits a centre, through an old DAC's grit.

machines.name: Bend
machines.description: Phase distortion after the Casio CZ: two lines read a cosine through bent phase maps, from sine to saw, pulse and resonant sweeps.

machines.name: Moth
machines.description: A west-coast complex oscillator: an FM'd sine through a wavefolder into a vactrol lowpass gate that pings, holds and glows.

machines.name: Sand
machines.description: A bowed plate covered in sand: grains rattle on its moving areas, then settle into the figure's nodal lines, leaving a glassy tone.

machines.name: Cocoa
machines.description: The hot chocolate effect: each note stirs bubbles into the drink and a spoon taps the mug, each tap ringing higher as the bubbles rise out.

machines.name: Coin
machines.description: Euler's disks spun on a mirror: each note's whirr rises along a finite-time power law through its ring, then stops dead.

machines.name: Fermi
machines.description: A Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou chain per note: its modes' energies are the partials. Low energy is a pure tone, middle breathes and returns, high thermalizes.

machines.name: Mach
machines.description: Each note flies past you at a Mach number you choose. Below Mach 1 a Doppler glide; above it, silence, a boom, then the sound forwards and backwards at once.

machines.name: Butterfly
machines.description: A struck chain of sites in a magnetic field: its energies (Hofstadter's butterfly) ring as partials, in q clusters at flux p/q.

machines.name: Drop
machines.description: A drop on a hot skillet: past the Leidenfrost point it floats as a star and beats at the key, stepping down its lobes as it evaporates.

machines.name: Ghost
machines.description: Apparitions between the ears: tuned resonators split harmonics, beat and circle round the listener's head.

machines.name: Recur
machines.description: A window of the sample laid out as a square and scrambled by Arnold's cat map, until it returns exactly.

machines.description: A global mod: one filter and envelope for every instrument track, set from aux track 12 (CV)

machines.name: Daath
machines.description: Daath: a witch house bass. Drifting saw swarm over a grave sub, hexed drive, murk, rot and tape wow, drawn as a living grimoire.

machines.name: Halcyon
machines.description: Halcyon: soft, near-pure ambient tones that swell, drift and shimmer

machines.name: Wander
machines.description: Wander: hold a key and ten of Colors In Space's key sounds wander in a scale of their own.

machines.name: Halcyon Keys
machines.description: Halcyon Keys: Halcyon's soft tones played in a scale. The white keys are the scale, so no key is ever out of it.

machines.name: Halcyon Wander
machines.description: Halcyon Wander: hold a key and Halcyon's soft tones wander in a scale of their own, after Mutable Instruments' Marbles.

machines.name: Acid Rain
machines.description: Highly optimized Open303 port: auto accent, gate, slide and octave jump, off or p-locked. pH and dew drive the sound and the rain lane. Melt your face off :)

machines.name: FELT
machines.description: An old upright piano prepared as Cage prepared his, with bolts, screws, rubber and paper between the strings, played as a drum kit.

machines.name: FLICKER
machines.description: A drum kit drawn on film: each key a shape inked on a 16 mm soundtrack and played through a projector's sound head.

machines.name: DUST
machines.description: A soul 45 on a portable record player as a drum kit: every key a hit from the break, played by the player's speed, needle, arm and dust brush.

machines.name: Acidline
machines.description: Mono acid voice with saw/triangle/square, resonant four-pole filter, octave-down sine sub, soft clipping and damping.

machines.name: Lustre
machines.description: A stereo granular bloom: soft overlapping grains, octave shimmer, reverse fragments and a diffuse reverb tail.

machines.name: Gen Tape
machines.description: Stereo tape color: organic wow and flutter, frequency-shaped saturation, four recorder voicings and shaped tape failures.

machines.name: Reaction
machines.description: One key, one living voice: a detuned saw pair over a sub-octave root, under a filter canopy that a tiny Gray-Scott ring keeps opening and closing.

machines.name: Diffusion
machines.description: Dub echo grown over by mould: reaction-diffusion rings cycle wow, resonance, orbit, wear and bloom through eroding repeats; Mould sets how wild.

extensions.name: Retrospective capture

extensions.note: Captures up to the track's length, as set in its settings.

extensions.name: Master DJ Filter
extensions.description: A resonant one-knob LP/neutral/HP master filter with an animated room.

extensions.name: Drumline page 2
extensions.description: Press an encoder on stock Drumline for a second page: each key's filter, sample rate and FX sends, with step locks.
extensions.note: Changes every Drumline track. Stock Drumline presets don't keep page 2.
